calendar.basis: union of canonical stock and market fact dates; not inferred from selected sector

distance_definition: mean absolute feature difference / max(abs(reference),1), plus missing-dimension share; no fitted transform or forward outcomes

amount_ratio.rule: last amount / first amount; require complete window and nonzero denominator

market_relative_return_pct.rule: entity compounded return minus index compounded return over identical days

return_pct.rule: compound every daily percentage in the declared window
